request.state:
Icelandic original: „Þorramatur og þjóðhátíðardagurinn“
English gloss: “Thorra foods and the national holiday. [Þorramatur refers to traditional Icelandic foods eaten during the month of Þorri; þjóðhátíðardagurinn is Iceland's National Day.]”
